title.en: Fable 19 — The Two Travellers and the Bear

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: Two friends walked in the forest.

sentences.ar: פתאום דוב גדול יצא מבין העצים.
sentences.en: Suddenly a big bear came out from between the trees.

sentences.ar: השני שכב על האדמה ולא זז.
sentences.en: The other lay on the ground and did not move.
The bear smelled him and left.

sentences.ar: החבר ירד ושאל מה הדוב אמר.
sentences.en: The friend came down and asked what the bear said.

sentences.ar: הוא ענה: אל תלך עם מי שבורח.
sentences.en: He answered: do not travel with someone who runs.
